summary: WP-P3 final bypass correction with the same eight authorized production paths. Preserve six function ports plus one mandatory repository-local non-secret store; no volatile or process-local authorization fallback exists. Every query re-reads the durable record and current WP-P2 readiness before retrieval, including same-process post-verification queries. Exported System/unified callTool semantic paths use an injected approved journey or the approved default journey and never raw retrieval fallback. Windows owner must equal the current identity exactly; both ACLs require effective current-user modify/full access after deny precedence and may grant protected access only to that identity and SYSTEM. Group owners, BUILTIN Users/Administrators, broad or foreign allows, missing identity, denied identity, permissive parent ACL, and the current host ACL fail closed with exact redacted remediation. Snapshots, graph-tidy, error whitelist, canonical authority, and runner-owned deliveryStatus remain protected.

explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Every query traverses durable read -> current WP-P2 read -> exact validation -> retrieval. TypeChecker-bound public dispatch permits only the approved operator query chain and rejects direct, aliased, helper, or resolver-delegated raw fallback. Windows trust requires exact current-user ownership and effective current-user/SYSTEM-only ACLs after deny precedence; each unsafe case returns the exact redacted remediation with zero retrieval.

tasks.title: Add non-secret readiness attestation lifecycle
tasks.objective: Make explicit readiness authorization survive process reconstruction while remaining version-bound and fail-closed.
steps: Implement exact Windows trust under the same-user/local-workspace boundary. Owner must equal current whoami identity, never a group. Parse each file/parent ACE, honor deny precedence, require effective current-user modify/full access, and permit protected allows only for current identity and NT AUTHORITY SYSTEM. Reject BUILTIN Users/Administrators, Everyone, Authenticated Users, arbitrary foreign allows, missing/denied current identity, malformed evidence, and permissive parent ACL.

For every Windows trust rejection set action exactly to: Restrict .argo/temp and semantic-readiness-attestation.json ownership and ACLs to the current OS identity and SYSTEM, then run semantic readiness again. Do not include raw ACL, identity, owner, path detail, stack, or secret.

Create the exact safe schema including authorizationOperation: verifyReadiness. Bind record() through resolved symbols to the active exclusive same-directory wx/0600 writer; complete write, file fsync/close, atomic rename, post-rename owner/file ACL checks, and supported-platform directory fsync. On Windows require an explicit same-directory rename fallback record; never silently omit durability, follow a dead helper, accept append/write, or authorize from presence.

Add the narrow readiness-attestation metadata factory to the existing sole command adapter without changing its credential factory. Bind whoami/icacls plus one fixed non-interactive Get-Acl Owner expression to exact repository directory/file paths; accept no caller path, script, command, flags, environment, stdin, or secret.
Keep six existing function ports unchanged and require the seventh readinessAttestationStore object with record/read/clear/validate at factory entry; delete the volatile fallback.
Clear on the actual init and explicit/automatic backfill paths. After explicit verifyReadiness returns exact verified:true, record the complete safe WP-P2 diagnostics and operation marker.

On every query, including same-process post-verification query, reject missing/invalid/untrusted evidence before readSemanticReadiness; if trusted, read WP-P2 once only to validate each exact attested version/channel. Clear and reject stale evidence with current safe diagnostics before retrieval. No process-local state may return early.
tasks.completionSignal: Cross-process and same-process queries both traverse durable validation; missing store construction fails; every owner/ACL matrix case rejects with exact remediation and zero retrieval; controlled current-user/SYSTEM ACL succeeds.

tasks.title: Route and serialize production adapters
tasks.objective: Make CLI, System MCP, unified MCP, and package boundaries preserve authorization, consent, and diagnostics.
steps: Create the shared exact eleven-field whitelist serializer and MCP error result. Derive every field only from error.<identicallyNamedField> using the frozen type normalization; force verified to exact true comparison and fullSnapshotFallback to literal false. Reject constants, cross-field mappings, message, stack, canaries, arbitrary properties, credentials, or unsafe source.
Refactor CLI process execution through runCliProcess with the default production factory and frozen injected composition seam; preserve request flags and output one JSON document.

Split System MCP raw semantic retrieval into a private delegate. Route exported System and unified callTool semantic getSystemArchitecture through an injected approved journey or approved default journey. Missing journey may fail closed but cannot invoke the raw delegate. Preserve validation, no-argument, graph-tidy, and JSON-RPC behavior exactly.

Compose the store in the default journey; invalidate before external backfill and after successful canonical write. Export handleRequest(request, dependencies) from both servers and pass dependencies through unified dispatch.
Remove --explicit-opt-in from the package script; do not add another implicit consent source.

Trust rationale: a durable local record is required because process memory is not an authorization boundary. The accepted canonical JSON authority already assumes a same-user local workspace, so this design adopts that explicit boundary rather than inventing a signing secret. A malicious process under the same OS identity can rewrite canonical JSON and is out of scope. Other identities, links/reparse points, permissive ACL/mode, corruption, malformed/extra fields, foreign records, and interrupted replacement are in scope and fail closed. The deterministic digest is only corruption/canonical-byte evidence; explicit-verification provenance derives from the guarded verifyReadiness writer path plus OS trust checks.

Windows ownership/ACL evidence remains in the eighth narrowly authorized production file systemMetadataCommandAdapter.js, but policy evaluation belongs privately in semanticReadinessAttestationStore.js. Exact owner equality and parsed ACE semantics are mandatory; the known current-host .argo/temp BUILTIN Users inheritance is a release blocker, not an exception.

Frozen runtime coverage now includes separate/same-process drift, missing durable store, exported no-journey callTool, presence-only/malformed/extra/tampered/foreign/link/atomic/invalidation/version cases, group owner, isolated BUILTIN Users, BUILTIN Administrators, and Authenticated Users file and parent allows, arbitrary foreign principal, missing current identity, current deny, broad principal, permissive parent, and current-host ACL evidence. Positive Windows workspaces remove inherited ACLs and grant only current identity/SYSTEM before use; controlled fixture metadata injection is composition-local and never weakens production policy.

The ninth guard additionally follows TypeChecker-resolved aliases/helpers from public callTool and accepts only the injected/default operator query chain, stopping traversal solely at the exact approved default factory. It rejects direct, aliased, helper, and resolver-delegated raw fallback, any query return before durable validation, dependency rewriting/volatile store creation, and executes the private Windows trust policy against safe and adversarial owner/ACE matrices.
